# Goodreads
> Discover, track, review, and discuss books with the world’s largest community of readers.

Goodreads helps readers find books they’ll love, organize reading lists, rate and review titles, browse genres and lists, and follow authors, friends, and literary news.

## Core Discovery
- [Home](https://www.goodreads.com/): Main discovery page featuring recommendations, quotes, lists, and literary news.
- [Search Books](https://www.goodreads.com/search): Search for books, authors, genres, and user-created lists.
- [Browse Genres](https://www.goodreads.com/genres): Explore books by genre, topic, and reading interest.
- [Book Lists](https://www.goodreads.com/list): Browse curated and user-voted lists of books.
- [Choice Awards](https://www.goodreads.com/choiceawards): Annual reader-voted awards across major book categories.
- [News & Interviews](https://www.goodreads.com/news): Editorial features, author interviews, and book-related news.
- [Quotes](https://www.goodreads.com/quotes): Discover popular literary quotes by book, author, and topic.

## Books & Reviews
- [Book Browse](https://www.goodreads.com/book): Entry point for Goodreads book pages and book discovery.
- [New Releases](https://www.goodreads.com/new_releases): Browse recently published and upcoming books by category.
- [Recommendations](https://www.goodreads.com/recommendations): Personalized book recommendations based on reading activity.
- [Giveaways](https://www.goodreads.com/giveaway): Enter book giveaways and browse current promotional listings.
- [Popular Books](https://www.goodreads.com/book/popular_by_date): See popular books by publication date and reader interest.
- [Review Guidelines Help](https://help.goodreads.com/): Help resources for ratings, reviews, shelves, and book pages.

## Lists, Genres & Awards
- [Best Books Ever](https://www.goodreads.com/list/show/1.Best_Books_Ever): Goodreads’ flagship community-voted list of top books.
- [Fiction Genre](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/fiction): Browse popular fiction titles, new books, and recommendations.
- [Fantasy Genre](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/fantasy): Explore fantasy books, series, and reader favorites.
- [Romance Genre](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/romance): Discover romance novels, lists, and trending titles.
- [Mystery Genre](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/mystery): Browse mystery and crime books with community ratings.
- [Historical Fiction Genre](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/historical-fiction): Explore historical fiction books and popular recommendations.
- [Science Fiction Genre](https://www.goodreads.com/genres/science-fiction): Find science fiction books, series, and reader favorites.

## Community & Social Reading
- [Groups](https://www.goodreads.com/group): Join reader groups organized around genres, themes, and interests.
- [Discussions](https://www.goodreads.com/topic): Participate in community discussions about books and reading.
- [User Profile](https://www.goodreads.com/user/show): View reader profiles, shelves, reviews, and activity.
- [Friends](https://www.goodreads.com/friend): Connect with friends and follow their reading activity.
- [Reading Challenge](https://www.goodreads.com/challenges): Set and track annual reading goals.
- [Recommendations from Friends](https://www.goodreads.com/recommendations): Get socially informed recommendations and reading suggestions.

## Authors & Publishing
- [Author Program](https://www.goodreads.com/author/program): Tools and information for authors on Goodreads.
- [Author Dashboard](https://www.goodreads.com/author/dashboard): Manage author presence, books, and reader engagement.
- [Author Blog News](https://www.goodreads.com/news?content_type=author_blogs): Posts and updates from authors and advertising partners.
- [Advertisers](https://www.goodreads.com/advertisers): Advertising options for publishers, authors, and book marketers.
- [Author Help](https://help.goodreads.com/): Support resources for author accounts and book management.

## Account & Access
- [Sign In](https://www.goodreads.com/user/sign_in): Log in to Goodreads with supported account options.
- [Join Goodreads](https://www.goodreads.com/user/sign_up): Create a Goodreads account to track and review books.
- [Help Center](https://help.goodreads.com/s/): Official support center for account, shelves, reviews, and policies.
- [Mobile Version](https://www.goodreads.com/toggle_mobile): Switch to Goodreads’ mobile web experience.
- [Ad Preferences](https://www.goodreads.com/adprefs): Manage Goodreads advertising preference settings.
- [Your Ads Privacy Choices](https://www.goodreads.com/ccbaprefs): Control privacy choices related to advertising and data use.

## Company & Support
- [About Us](https://www.goodreads.com/about/us): Learn about Goodreads, its mission, and company background.
- [Careers](https://www.goodreads.com/jobs): Explore job openings and employment information.
- [Help](https://www.goodreads.com/help?action_type=help_web_footer): Access support and frequently asked questions.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.goodreads.com/about/terms): Legal terms governing use of Goodreads services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.goodreads.com/about/privacy): Goodreads privacy practices and data handling details.
- [Interest-Based Ads Notice](https://help.goodreads.com/s/article/Goodreads-Interest-Based-Ads-Notice): Information about interest-based advertising on Goodreads.
